title: NFL trench follow-up: recalibrate, then scheme mixer, then sack/hit flags
kill_switch: Set status to done here AND syndicate_trench_followup.status='done' on test when this work ships or is explicitly dropped. That stops the Tuesday /theo nag.

order.note: Shipped 1.4.147. Z-score PBWR/PRWR/RBWR/RSWR inside the loaded vintage. Same home-minus-away pairing. 55/45 blend. TRENCH_Z_TO_POINTS=0.56. House gate 0.8 points, not a z cutoff.

Done 2026-09-29. scripts/syndicate-trench-recalibrate.mjs on weeks 1-3: out-of-sample +1.2 ±1.6 pts per z (32 games), trench flag covered 7/12. Too noisy to move, kept 0.56. Added team z cap ±2.5 (GB PBWR 16). Board history now in nfl_trench_board_snapshots + data/syndicate/espn-nfl-2026-trench-history.json. Re-run the script at Week 8.

Weight mixer only. Mute pass-trench from time-to-throw or air-yards share (not a hard <=5 air yards cut). Screens/WR screens should mute rush; a 4-yard out on 3rd-and-7 should not. If TTT is missing, air_yards + qb_dropback + pass_location is enough. 12-personnel from personnel_offense bumps run. Caps: pass weight never below ~0.35, run never above ~0.60. Do not ship in week 1-2.

Flag, do not overwrite. Sack/hit rate from the same Tuesday nflverse job. If |z(PBWR) - z(1 - sack rate allowed)| >= 1.5, tag process!=outcome and haircut trench points (about x0.6). Kill the August fake pressure_rate_* leftovers. Do not scrape PFF.
